claim_boundary: deterministic descriptive attention-head and source support; no causal claim, intervention-derived selection, or execution authorization

required: complete lossless canonical VINDEX3 run record
HEAD-OBS-1 HeadsObserved, HeadWrite, HeadSum and CarrierStats events
input_authority.source_level_additional_requirement: lossless same-run source-evidence sidecar from borrowed AttentionHeadRecord values, bound to the observation receipt
input_authority.stats_only_rule: HeadWrite source positions and attention weights permit attention-mass summaries only; refuse source contribution, share and role contribution without full source values
input_authority.forbidden_shortcut: attention weight is never substituted for source contribution
input_authority.source_sidecar_execution: evidence captured from the canonical borrowed tap; never a second attention execution

support_coordinate.coordinate_id: sha256 of canonical JSON over the coordinate object only, sorted keys, UTF-8, no insignificant whitespace, integers preserved
support_coordinate.stability_rule: same logical model, plan and input layout emit the same coordinate ID across replay and supported backends

support_observation.observation_id: sha256 of canonical JSON over the observation object only under the coordinate canonicalization rule
support_observation.replay_rule: same sealed execution reproduces coordinate and observation IDs
support_observation.backend_rule: supported backends share the coordinate ID and have distinct observation IDs whose measurements are compared

descriptive_record.transition_instance_rule: record envelope only; excluded from coordinate hash
descriptive_record.missing_evidence_rule: coverage_status refused with a reason; never impute from another coordinate or execution

contribution_algebra.source_input: u[h,t] = gate[h] elementwise_mul (attention_probability[h,t] * value[kv_head,t]); omit gate when absent
contribution_algebra.applied_transform: G = residual_scale * alpha * gain; without post norm alpha and gain are one
contribution_algebra.applied_bias: d_bias = G elementwise_mul output_bias; zero when bias absent
contribution_algebra.weight_authority: effective prepared production realization used by the observed run; widened checkpoint weights forbidden
contribution_algebra.once_only_bias: separate bias coordinate; never assigned to a head or source

reader_projection.secondary_normalization: l2_normalize/v1 as a separately hashed, always-declared diagnostic that cannot replace the primary
reader_projection.basis_freeze: token IDs, transforms, prepared-image fingerprint, realization and vector hashes fixed before observation
reader_projection.head: p_head[h,j] = dot(reader[j], d[h])
reader_projection.dla_boundary: only selected_token_row/v1 with identity/v1 is direct output-head projection in logit units; a normalized reader is not DLA
reader_projection.true_lens_boundary: linear selected-token projection is not nonlinear true-lens logit change; standing/rank joins separately from Readout
reader_projection.signed_head_share: p_head / p_site; absent on unstable denominator
reader_projection.signed_source_share: p_source / p_head; absent on unstable denominator
reader_projection.cancellation_rule: report signed and absolute surfaces separately; never clip or renormalize cancellation away

source_roles.authority: construction-time token spans in the frozen prompt-structure manifest
source_roles.forbidden_assignment: decoded-string search or post-run hand adjudication
source_roles.overlap_rule: BOS, RELATION and ENTITY spans must be mutually disjoint or the role map refuses
source_roles.last_rule: final prompt position only when it has no earlier role; LAST may be empty
source_roles.unlabelled_rule: generated positions and unlabelled template positions are OTHER
source_roles.range_rule: positions outside the visible source range refuse; never clip

acceptance_gates.coverage: every eligible HeadsObserved event has exactly the declared query-head set and every visible source row; no missing or duplicate coordinate
acceptance_gates.refusal_accounting: every uncovered operator/layer, missing sidecar, truncated source surface, unstable denominator and unsupported norm is explicit
acceptance_gates.deterministic_replay: canonical serialization and every coordinate ID byte-identical across two transforms of the same sealed inputs
acceptance_gates.backend_agreement: where reference and production are both defined, identical coordinate set and abs(a-b) <= 1e-5 * max(1, abs(a), abs(b)) for every scalar measurement
acceptance_gates.full_gate: all gates conjunctive; head-only output with refused sources cannot open source-level consumers

claim_vocabulary.application: serialized schema keys and enum/string labels; free-form refusal messages may quote upstream errors
claim_vocabulary.winner_rule: no winning-head selection or mechanism nickname

sealed_witness.row_selection: lexicographically smallest train TransitionIdentity in the frozen GW-0 manifest with all three prompt families; canonical prompt family
sealed_witness.pass: all acceptance gates, exact serialization round-trip, and identical artifact hash on a second transform of the sealed evidence
sealed_witness.claim: lawful descriptive normalization on one real-model row only

downstream.gw_ts_1: may copy coordinate and descriptive measurements into physical_support but cannot change coordinates from recurrence or prediction
downstream.attr_1c_object: separate CausalSupportEvidence referencing support_coordinate_id and baseline_support_observation_id, and carrying intervention identity, observed effect, control effect and verdict
downstream.backflow: intervention results never update ATTR-1D coordinates, normalization, readers, roles or records

amendment.reason: baseline execution identity inside SupportCoordinate contradicted the frozen cross-backend identical-coordinate gate

amendment_rule: ontology, algebra, reader/role mapping, gates and vocabulary changes require an explicit amendment and new contract identity; witness results live separately
